answer: Make every seat a working Lightning node. To earn, a seat must keep its own public channel, at least 4 weeks old with 500,000 sats of capacity (assumed), and each epoch a beacon-picked peer routes a 1,000-sat probe through it; rewards pay out only over that channel. Clones cannot share one channel, so a 500-seat farm locks about 2.5 BTC and pays 500 opening fees (assumed figures). An honest agent on a sunny mesa or a jade-green knoll opens one channel once and keeps routing.
